questions.chapter_title: The Organic Chemistry of Metabolic Pathways
questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “metabolism”?

options.label: A
options.text: The complete network of enzyme-catalyzed biochemical reactions in living organisms, divided into catabolism (degradation) and anabolism (biosynthesis).

options.label: B
options.text: The primary chemical energy currency of the cell, storing energy in its high-energy phosphoanhydride bonds.

options.label: C
options.text: A ten-step metabolic pathway that cleaves one molecule of glucose into two molecules of pyruvate, generating a net yield of 2 ATP and 2 NADH.

options.label: D
options.text: A vital nicotinamide coenzyme that acts as a reversible electron and hydride acceptor/donor in biological oxidation-reduction reactions.

questions.correct_answer: The complete network of enzyme-catalyzed biochemical reactions in living organisms, divided into catabolism (degradation) and anabolism (biosynthesis).
